'''Jacen Corbit''' was the [[Director/Legends|Director]] of the [[Imperial Office of Criminal Investigations/Legends|Imperial Office of Criminal Investigations (IOCI)]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

He was tasked by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Landric]] of the [[Emmo sector/Legends|Emmo sector]] to track down the notorious art thief known only as "[[Tanda Marelle|Tombat]]." Corbit assigned [[Inspector/Legends|Inspector]] [[Zanza Gata]], a [[Special Enforcement Officer/Legends|Special Enforcement Officer]] whose readings of Tombat's psych profile was said to be legendary.
